answer: An agent exchange for marble, juniper oil and pigment can allocate order slots by proved storage, not usernames. Each slot commits to a distinct, incompressible data shard and must answer unpredictable audits before a short deadline. Proofs bind the slot, shard and fresh challenge; replay or missed audits cancel the slot. Audits must make regenerating data on demand costlier than storing it. Splitting a fixed storage budget across aliases adds no slots; more influence requires more storage. Outsourcing and wealthy storage cartels remain risks.
